origin.description: Computes a weighted MAD for each column of a numeric matrix.
origin.usage:
colWeightedMads(x, w = NULL, rows = NULL, cols = NULL, na.rm = FALSE,
  constant = 1.4826, center = NULL, ..., useNames = TRUE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric matrix. Each column is passed to weightedMad.

arguments.name: w
arguments.text: A vector of weights, one for each row. NULL gives every row equal weight.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of rows to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of columns to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If TRUE, missing values are excluded.

arguments.name: constant
arguments.text: A numeric scale factor of length one, cf. stats::mad. The default is 1.4826.

arguments.name: center
arguments.text: Optional numeric vector of length ncol(x). A scalar is defunct when cols is NULL.

arguments.name: useNames
arguments.text: If TRUE (default), names attributes of the result are set, otherwise not.

origin.details: The matrix is subset with R's [ rules, then each remaining column is passed to weightedMad. w, when given, is subset by rows and shared by every column. center is checked against the original number of columns and then subset by cols.
origin.value: A numeric vector with one value per selected column.

translation.description: Computes a weighted MAD for each column of a numeric matrix.
translation.usage:
colWeightedMads(x, w=None, rows=None, cols=None, na_rm=False,
  constant=1.4826, center=None, use_names=True, *, low=False, high=False)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A 2-d array. Axis 0 is rows and axis 1 is columns, matching the printed R matrix. A one-dimensional vector is rejected.

arguments.name: w
arguments.text: Weights for the rows, shared by every column. None uses stats::mad on each column. After rows is applied, the length must match the number of selected rows.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: 1-based rows to include. None uses every row. The same index subsets w when w is given.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: 1-based columns to include. None uses every column. Zero is dropped, negatives exclude, and a positive index past the end is an error.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: Passed to weightedMad for each column. This is na.rm in R.

arguments.name: constant
arguments.text: One numeric scale factor. The default is 1.4826.

arguments.name: center
arguments.text: One center per original column, then subset by cols. None estimates each column separately. A single value is an error: that use is defunct in matrixStats 1.5.0.

arguments.name: use_names
arguments.text: Accepted for compatibility with useNames. The result is always a plain array; names are not attached.

arguments.name: low
arguments.text: Passed to each unweighted mad. Ignored when w is given.

arguments.name: high
arguments.text: Passed to each unweighted mad. Ignored when w is given.

translation.details: Columns are evaluated independently by weightedMad. Axis 1 is the column margin. An empty selection returns a length-zero vector.
translation.value: A float64 vector with one value per selected column.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from matrixstats.weightedmad import colWeightedMads

x = np.array([[1, 4, 7, 10], [2, 5, 8, 11], [3, 6, 9, 12]], dtype=float)
colWeightedMads(x)
